notes.title: Unveiling v1.2 Release and LT Game Awards nominations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787415/e7130ffdc95b7fd9c316c030507ac48b5c4200ca.png[/img]

We're happy to announce that [b]Unveiling[/b] was nominated for [b]Best Audio[/b], [b]Best Art Direction[/b], and [b]Game of the Year[/b] categories in the [b]Lithuanian Game Awards 2023[/b].

To mark the occasion, we're releasing a 1.2 version with much-requested subtitle support (English, and Lithuanian languages), gameplay changes, and major bug fixes. 

Eyes to the sky, people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787415/f643868f68de34750fb1add6f2e9e80d72e08c96.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Transparent background to UI overlay elements.
[*] Version display in most menus.
[*] Voice-over subtitles for English and Lithuanian languages.
[*] Modulation for background audio at the Museum level.
[*] Fading to ending cinematic audio transitions.
[*] Soft wind effect on trees at the Museum level.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Most gravity surfaces in Museum Hall 04 will reset gravity after jumping.
[*] Optimized Museum level by disabling sections and areas that are no longer accessible.
[*] Increased trigger size for all puzzles at the Museum level.
[*] Pre-solved pieces of some puzzles at the Museum level.
[*] Increased delay before playing ending cinematic animations.
[*] Museum door dissolve effect to be less generic.
[*] Split the first puzzle into two pieces.
[*] Reduced LOD bias to improve performance.
[*] Optimized terrain rendering which should greatly improve performance in Forest levels.
[*] Slightly reduced Low & Medium preset rendering quality.
[*] Reduced Car animation delay in the final level.
[*] Improved debugging tools.
[*] Increased puzzle trigger size to make assembling puzzles more forgiving.
[*] Credits background audio.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players being able to get out of the Forest area and fall out of bounds.
[*] Players being able to get out of the Lake area and fall out of bounds.
[*] Wisps & Swamp zones not deactivating when the Lake fog effect triggers.
[*] Dark seams visible on Forest terrain in some areas.
[*] Lithuanian localization mentioning FMOD twice in Credits.
[*] Player being able to turn the camera during the final level camera transition.
[*] Camera randomly turning to the side during the intro cinematic after UFO encounters.
[*] Rock gaps in Museum Hall 02.
[*] Water waves not working in Museum Hall 05.
[*] Shadow in Museum Entrance Balcony acting weird.
[*] Voice-overs not pausing.
[*] Car SFX artifacts/distortion in the final level.
[*] Rock LOD pop-in at the Museum level by adding cross-fading.
[/list]
